name: Anorexia nervosa
summary: Restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, with intense fear of weight gain and disturbed body image. Treatment centers on nutritional rehabilitation, medical monitoring, and psychotherapy (family-based treatment for adolescents). No medication is FDA-approved; olanzapine has the most trial support for weight gain.
plainSummary: Anorexia makes people eat far too little because they are very afraid of gaining weight. Treatment focuses on safe refeeding and therapy; there is no approved medicine, though some are used to help with weight gain or anxiety.
noApprovedNote: No medication is FDA-approved for anorexia nervosa. A 2025 review of eating-disorder pharmacotherapy (2010–2025) found no approvals for AN, and searches for 2024–2026 FDA actions found none.

offLabel.use: Promoting weight gain in adult outpatients
offLabel.notes: A 16-week multisite RCT (n=152) found a modestly greater monthly BMI increase than placebo (about 0.26 vs 0.10 kg/m2 per month) with no benefit on obsessional symptoms. Low doses (2.5–10 mg/day) were used. Monitor glucose, lipids, sedation, QT, and EPS; patients may resist weight-promoting medication. Evidence in adolescents is limited.

details.labeledFor: FDA-approved for schizophrenia, bipolar I disorder, and (with fluoxetine) treatment-resistant depression; not for anorexia nervosa.

dosing.target: 5 mg/day; the 16-week RCT titrated within 2.5–10 mg/day (mean about 7 mg)
dosing.notes: Give at bedtime. Check weight, glucose, lipids, and QTc; monitor for refeeding complications.

boxedWarnings: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis
warnings: QT prolongation and arrhythmia risk at very low weight
details.plainSummary: An antipsychotic used in small doses to help adults with anorexia gain weight. It can cause sleepiness and blood sugar or cholesterol changes.

references.label: Attia E et al. Olanzapine versus placebo in adult outpatients with anorexia nervosa: RCT. Am J Psychiatry 2019 (PMID 30654643)
